description_expanded: ABOUT HIDDEN BEACH VILLAS: Welcome to Hidden Beach Villas, a charming beachfront community nestled in the picturesque surroundings of 30A. HBV 111 is an inviting studio condo offering a warm and cozy ambiance, complete with a delightful patio for relaxing outdoors. Just a brief stroll from the beach and mere moments away from a spacious community pool, this accommodation is perfectly situated for a relaxing getaway. Start your day by savoring a cup of morning coffee on the patio as you plan your beach activities or a leisurely bike ride along 30A. Alternatively, unwind with a good book in hand and immerse yourself in the tranquil atmosphere. HBV 111 caters to various needs, whether you seek a weekend escape, an extended winter retreat, or a week-long vacation. With a queen-sized Murphy bed and a comfortable queen sleeper sofa, HBV 111 accommodates small families or groups of friends seeking a change of scenery. The well-equipped kitchen provides all the essentials for preparing home-cooked meals, ensuring a convenient and enjoyable stay for your loved ones, including your four-legged family member. Secure your reservation and embark on a memorable vacation experience at HBV 111 today. ABOUT THE AREA: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community located along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach epitomizes the laid-back and picturesque beach lifestyle that the area is known for. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, emerald green waters, and towering sand dunes, Seagrove Beach offers a serene and relaxed ambiance that attracts visitors looking for a peaceful getaway. The beach in Seagrove is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and simply enjoying the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. In addition to its beautiful beach, Seagrove Beach is surrounded by natural beauty, including rare coastal dune lakes, pine forests, and state parks. Visitors can explore hiking and biking trails, go birdwatching, or take a leisurely walk along the scenic coastline to appreciate the area's unique ecosystem. Seagrove Beach is also home to a variety of charming beach cottages, luxury vacation rentals, boutique shops, and delicious restaurants serving fresh seafood and local cuisine. The community has a laid-back and friendly vibe, making it a favorite destination for families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts looking to unwind and reconnect with nature. Along Scenic Highway 30A, visitors can explore neighboring beach communities, each with its own distinct character and amenities. From art galleries and coastal dune lakes to live music events and farmers markets, there is always something to see and do along this scenic stretch of coastline. Overall, Seagrove Beach is a hidden gem along Scenic Highway 30A, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, relaxation, and Southern hospitality that captures the essence of the Florida Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Santa Clara RBA / Pelayo Street Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 2 minute walk to the beach. * Community pool. PARKING: * Free Parking up to 1 Vehicle. PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * If you choose to bring your dog/s, there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $50 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. * Must Be 25 years or older DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
